answer: Locks are logged in sparrow, expire in ledge, and haven lists each expiry. An adversary running 100 aliases therefore needs 187 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4992 identities would post 615 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
